text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Twin Turbo kept race fans on the edge of their seats with her running.
"A run remembered above all others. A sheer absurdity that earned her praise—"

Permission to run in a certain race was granted.
Yes, that race was...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The view from the front—I won't give it up.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let anyone get ahead of me. Even if
every single runner around me is a Front Runner."

A memorial race gathering only Front-Runner Umamusume.
Legendary front-runners who etched their names into history have assembled all in one place.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha. You're fired up, Suzuka-san.
Everyone else is too. But that's exactly why...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There are always ways to pull a fast one on them.
Now then, how should I spring my trap~?

Super-fast Umamusume Silence Suzuka is here,
as well as the clever tactician Umamusume, Seiun Sky.
In the midst of all that—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
1, 2, Turbo! 2, 2, Turbo!
Now, what's Turbo's strategy?
(Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaasssshaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Deeeeyaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She's just... going all out with wild abandon?!
At this rate, we can't even trap her in our strategy...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, is this... running away?

Twin Turbo's reckless, all-out running style
left the other Umamusume utterly rattled.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If you were to ask me if this is what it means to "lead"...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Strictly speaking, it might be different.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It means there are five running styles in the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Front Runner," "Pace Setter," "Late Attacker," "End Closer"...
And then—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'm "Twin Turbo."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The running style known as 'Twin Turbo' is likely
a collaborative creation between you and Turbo-san."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it is the fruition born of two people
who wished to burn with all their might—and help each other do so.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa,
Turbo, EXPLOOOOOODE!!!!!!
(WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Win or lose, the crowd still roars like this.
This excitement. This sheer fun...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Who on earth could ever create
such wild frenzy?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why...
the one who can inherit this factor is...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ah, no no no. Turbo's front-running isn't like that~.

text_block_list.name: Turbo's Pupil
text_block_list.text: I, I see... I kind of felt a sense of destiny about it, but...

text_block_list.name: Turbo's Pupil
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I try, I just can't win at all.
So, I'm just...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, you're giving up~?
Hey! Hey, wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, Trainer...

Twin Turbo's disciples left the academy one after
another. Not a single one remained. However...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!?

Yes, even if we cannot inherit "destiny,"
there is another factor—
Those who inherit that “inspiration” surely will.

—After that. Tokyo Racecourse.
The Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"This has turned into an outrageous race!
The leading Umamusume runs away, building a massive lead!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An unbelievable runaway lead by a massive margin!
Can they really catch up?! Can anyone really reach her—?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Not yet! She's still leading the breakaway! The gap is colossal!
This running...! This running is just like...!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo!!!!!
It's an all-out, burnout run that calls to mind that unforgettable Twin Turbo!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: O... O... Oooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Turbo saw someone.
Someone who runs just like Turbo!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, they're definitely going to show up.
Yeah, there's no doubt they'll show up.

text_block_list.text:
Destiny isn't the only factor. From among the Umamusume
who were deeply moved by Twin Turbo's race...

"A successor will surely appear.
Saying, 'I want to amaze everyone just like that too.'"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Run, run, run!
Turbo, full throttle—!!!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Go, chase them down!!
Overtake, overtake, overtake them-m-m!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Total! Complete! Burnouttttt!!!!!!!
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

There are plenty of legendary Front Runners.
But no matter how strong you are, that alone
isn't enough to make the racetrack roar.

"All or nothing.
Only those willing to burn it all away—"

Called the "Twin Turbo of [X],"
she carries on that determination and excitement.
